name: Sonora Resort All-Inclusive
positioning: Remote Relais & Châteaux wilderness resort in the Discovery Island archipelago on British Columbia's West Coast, with ocean-facing lodges, private villas and guided outdoor adventures
best_for: Travelers who want guided wilderness adventures like Chinook fishing, rainforest hikes, grizzly bear viewing and helicopter trips
Families and groups wanting multi-bedroom suites or private villas

facts.text: Sonora Resort is in the heart of the Discovery Island archipelago on the rugged West Coast of British Columbia.
The resort sits in an ancient British Columbia rainforest archipelago with eagles, whales and bears.
Sonora became a member of Relais & Châteaux in 2009.
The resort's spa is Island Currents Spa, offering treatments and specialty therapies.
Rooms, suites and villas use cedar and stone craftsmanship and picture windows, with views over the Yuculta Rapids and Innes Passage.
Rooms are in ocean-facing lodges, each with common lounges, stone fireplaces and hot tubs.
On-island activities include lake paddling, archery, trout pond fishing and guided hikes.
Experiences also include ocean adventures that cruise islands, inlets and waterfalls looking for local wildlife.
The kitchen works with local suppliers for organic meats, locally caught seafood and micro-greens.
The resort works with its local community and Indigenous partners for its guest experiences.

highlights.text: Suites range from two to six bedrooms, with indoor and outdoor hot tubs, fireplaces and balconies overlooking sea lions in the kelp beds.
Guests can fish for Chinook in the channels and rapids of the Discovery Islands, hike old-growth rainforest and watch grizzly bears in their natural habitat.
The private villas, Sea Lion Pointe House and Eagle Rock Lodge, sit in their own private locations with art collections, towering fireplaces and outdoor terraces.

Facilities include an outdoor heated pool, rooftop hot tubs, mineral pools, a covered indoor tennis court, a movie theatre, a nine-hole putting green, virtual golf, fly-fishing ponds, saunas and a fitness center.

considerations.text: The resort is remote: it is reached in 50 minutes by air from Vancouver, or by sea from Vancouver Island.
WhataHotel notes limited connectivity and cell service.
